name: Our Feelings
overview: Scripture warns against trusting our own feelings and understanding, emphasizing instead a wholehearted trust in the LORD. The Proverbs passages reveal that relying on one's own heart or judgment leads to folly and death, while seeking wise counsel brings deliverance. Isaiah encourages believers not to fear or be dismayed, assuring God's strength and help even when our emotions may be troubled. Together, these verses teach that our feelings are unreliable guides, and true wisdom and peace come from depending on God's truth and sustaining power.
